== Notes ==
* Deathly Swarm is rather similar to [[Chain Lightning]]. It is a non-[[projectile]] spell with standard spell [[range]]. It does not ''immediately'' strike target foe (as most spells do), there is a delay before doing so.
:* 1 second after spell activation, the spell triggers on the target foe.
:* 2 seconds after spell activation, the spell triggers on a ''second'' foe [[in the area]] of the primary target.
:* 3 seconds after spell activation, the spell triggers on a ''third'' foe in the area of the secondary target.
*The casting animation resembles a pentagram around the target.

== Trivia ==
*During early development, this skill was called 'Vile Swarm', as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
